reports.title: Oswego River fishing report
reports.text: Bass are being caught as well.

reports.title: Skaneateles Lake fishing report
reports.text: Bass are also starting to bite. For information on how to catch bass, view Fishing for Largemouth and Smallmouth Bass.

reports.title: Cayuga Lake fishing report
reports.text: Try for perch and crappie by jigging with small jig heads, throwing blade baits, or using small minnows in around 15 to 20 feet of water.

reports.title: Oneida Lake fishing report
reports.text: Bass can be caught post-spawn in the shallows on rattle-traps, jerkbaits, spinnerbaits, and chatterbaits. Smallmouth bass can be found in deeper water around 15 to 50 feet near logs or rock piles.

reports.title: Otisco Lake fishing report
reports.text: Crappie can be caught in and around fallen trees and woody debris using minnows under a bobber.
